title.title: Additive \(k\)-colorable extensions of the rational plane

editorial_contributions.text:
Summary: [For the entire collection see Zbl 0701.00006.] 


The concept of difference arrays was introduced by \textit{R. Mukerjee} [Sankhya, Ser. B 44, 154-166 (1982; Zbl 0552.62053)]. Such arrays are generalisations of balanced and orthogonal arrays. This paper describes two methods for the construction of difference arrays, suggests main effect plans based on them and studies the properties of such plans.
